input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. The numbers and words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' keep exactly the same upright shapes in every frame and stay fully visible. A young Japanese woman at a warm whisky bar looks into the camera with a calm face. Slowly, her eyes soften and the corners of her mouth lift into a very soft, gentle, closed-mouth smile, warm and kind, like quietly welcoming a friend. A subtle, tender smile, lips closed, no teeth showing. Her head stays almost still, her shoulders, chest and T-shirt do not move at all; she does not lean or breathe heavily. Only her face changes. Warm bokeh lights glimmer softly in the background. Avoid: zoom, zooming in, zooming out, camera push-in, dolly, pan, tilt, camera shake, garbled text, changing letters, misspelled words, nonsense text, extra text, new text, morphing print, print redrawing, warped logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, face morphing, identity change, different person, teeth distortion, flicker, watermark, captions, subtitles, teeth, big grin, laughing, wide open mouth, exaggerated expression, smirk, fabric movement, T-shirt wrinkles moving, hair covering the print
